description: Duomenys apie asmenis, kuriems teisės aktų nustatyta tvarka išduoti kvalifikacijos pažymėjimai rengti žemėtvarkos planavimo dokumentus ir (ar) matininko ir (ar) geodezininko kvalifikacijos pažymėjimai is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Valstybės duomenų agentūra. Information on persons to whom valid qualification certificates for preparing land management planning documents, surveyor or geodesist qualification certificates have been issued in accordance with the procedure established by legal acts. Coverage: Valstybės duomenų agentūra. The portal shows the English title as "Data on persons to whom certificates of qualification for preparing land management planning documents and/or surveyor's" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Valstybės duomenų agentūra. Its keywords include Pažymėjimas, Matininkas, Vda, Registras, Kvalifikacija, Geodezininkas. The listing shows 4 download or service links in RDF, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
